notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.16.0.

Bill amount now always matches the printed bill
- New "Amount to charge" box when collecting payment. If the customer pays Rs 700 on a Rs 710 bill, type 700: the bill prints the Rs 10 reduction as "Round off / Discount" and the total Rs 700.
- The bill now also prints "Cash received" and "Change returned", so the real amount the customer handed over is visible on paper.
- Blocked: charging more than the bill, or cash received less than the amount to charge. Reducing a bill needs the discount permission or an admin PIN, and is written to the audit log.
- Shift report shows how many bills were reduced at payment and by how much.
- After ending a shift, the admin can send the shift summary on WhatsApp.
